correctness.rationale: Normalize right Hatano–Nelson sine eigenstates; the derivative of its real normalized amplitude equals (j−E j)/(2θ) times the amplitude, so QFI=Var(j)/θ². Fixed m gives tilted sine² integral; r=min(m,n−m)→∞ gives tilted uniform law by a uniform summation-by-parts O(1/r) bound. Log second derivative yields V_m(u)=V∞(u)+2(u²−(2πm)²)/(u²+(2πm)²)². For |u|<2π all fixed m lose to bulk; for |u|>2π m=1 uniquely maximizes limiting family, with subsequence argument upgrading to finite-N endpoint selection. Equality excluded. Independent 72 finite-score and quadrature tests corroborate only the finite/numerical components.
